facts.fact: Ben 以 1928 现实为由再次禁止 Clara 进城侦查——「女人跟着只会引人注意」；Clara 自嘲读过的独立女性故事原来不真实。
facts.anchor: It’s a fact of life in 1928, Clara. You have to deal with it.

facts.fact: Ben 留下的补偿承诺：回家后查她父母是否也懂穿越；Clara 被派去陪 Mrs. Allen 挖记忆。
facts.anchor: “When we go home, I will move heaven and earth to discover everything I can about the possibility of your parents knowing how to go through the passages, okay?”

facts.fact: Quint 的求爱论证：「你的脸的线条我像我自己的一样熟，能凭记忆画出每条曲线」——我们已是彼此的，整整一生。
facts.anchor: But I know the lines of your face as well as I know my own.

facts.fact: 1928 夜装：粉红 shift dress、银额带羽毛、红唇——从 1901 的拘谨变成 flapper。
facts.anchor: Everything about my time in 1901 had been demure. Tonight I’m part flapper

facts.fact: Clara 回忆 Ben 的吻时惊觉：记忆里的脸全是 Quint 的——记忆正在被置换。
facts.anchor: But for the life of me, I can’t put anyone but Quint’s face to those memories, and not exactly those.

facts.fact: 与 Quint 共舞整晚，Ben 完全没在她脑中出现——这种「遗忘」让她毛骨悚然。
facts.anchor: It strikes me in a horrible way to think that I’ve forgotten about Ben.

facts.fact: Ben 楼梯口抓包对峙：让 Ben 吻她反而像背叛 Quint——感情天平已经倾斜。
facts.anchor: letting Ben kiss me feels like betraying Quint.

facts.fact: Clara+Quint 的侦查法：调全部本地报纸，逐篇找 Gibbons 可能干预的事件——下午拼出线索清单帮到 Ben。
facts.anchor: When Mrs. Barrow, the housekeeper, appears, he requests copies of all the local newspapers.

facts.fact: Clara 对 Quint 完全坦诚：讲 Ben 救她的往事，承认「有时觉得自己注定与他在一起，就像注定与你在一起」。
facts.anchor: “There are times when I think that I am as destined to be with him as I feel destined to be with you.”

facts.fact: Quint 回忆她母亲；Clara 说母亲「timeless」——爱 1940s 老电影、vintage 店买裙、传家的宽檐帽：母亲的穿越痕迹。
facts.anchor: “She was timeless,” I say when I can speak without the thickness of emotion.

facts.fact: 相册铁证：1911 年金发男孩与小女孩牵手的照片——「是亲戚我毫不怀疑，是我我几乎确定」。
facts.anchor: That it’s me, I’m nearly sure.

facts.fact: 照片里的第二位女士就是 Clara 的母亲（与 Mrs. Allen 并坐）——1911 的 The Villa 有她母亲的实证。
facts.anchor: The image is faded, but a wave of emotion rises in my chest as I gaze at a picture of my mother.

facts.fact: Quint 直白求留：「What if you were born in the past?」+「I love you」+「Stay with me」；Clara 答：「Heaven help me, Quint, I can’t.」
facts.anchor: “I love you.” His voice shoots through me like that same bolt of lightning

facts.fact: 章末：Gibbons 现身门厅叫出真名、索要 McCann 镜子、开枪击穿 Clara 左肩——她在 Quint 的呼喊声里陷入黑暗。
facts.anchor: His arm rises. A crack splits the room.
